sentences.en: The threat increases; a defence that doesn't evolve is meaningless.
sentences.zh: 威胁越来越大；不发展变化的防御毫无意义。

sentences.en: All living beings would have evolved from a common ancestor.
sentences.zh: 所有生物都源自同一个祖先。

sentences.en: A language is a living system that evolves over time.
sentences.zh: 语言是一种随着时间演变的活生生的系统。

senses.zh: 发展，进展；进化；逐步形成
发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出
